steps.stdout:
In Chrome, open chrome://extensions and enable Developer mode.
Choose Load unpacked, then select: /home/ubuntu/.local/lib/nockapp-beta/extension
Copy NockApp's extension ID, then run: python3 SETUP.py --extension-id YOUR_EXTENSION_ID

NockApp is installed. Open its Chrome sidebar to browse or publish.
Twitter and wallet badges are optional. Do not repeat an uncertain payment.
